title: Extensibility
slide_intent: Show a family resemblance because future products need a visible connection without becoming indistinguishable.
strategic_value: Shared isometric geometry can connect Dropbox and Paper while allowing another concept to take a different form.
demonstration: Three blue forms appear in a row: the Dropbox mark, overlapping Paper diamonds and a hexagonal future-concept form, each with an orange handwritten label.
practical_value: Compare how much geometry can change while preserving a related visual language.
